verdict.rationale: Canny's evidence covers feedback capture, integrations (Jira, Linear, GitHub, etc.), changelog, and an MCP server for querying/acting on feedback data, but there is no mention of automated workflow builders for SLAs, trial extensions, or discount offers triggered by feedback events. Missing for 10: any SLA automation, trial-extension logic, discount-offer triggers, or general conditional workflow/rules engine tied to feedback events.
